# `loans.personal_loan.PersonalDataErasureRequested`

The data subject's GDPR Article 17 right-to-be-forgotten was exercised on this loan: the subject's encryption key was crypto-shredded ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P3), so every PII ciphertext under it is now permanently unrecoverable. The erasure FACT is structural-only (no field was, or could resolve to, the erased personal data), so it may itself ride the durable bus as a cascade signal. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2).

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | The loan whose subject's PII was erased — a structural id, not PII. |
| `subject_pseudonym` | `string` | A SALTED, ONE-WAY hash of the data-subject id ([ADR-IC-016](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-016-service-identity-and-mtls.md) §8 / [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — an opaque correlation reference a consumer can cascade its own deletion on, NEVER the raw subject id. |
| `erased_on` | `int` (`date`) | The date the erasure took effect (audit lineage) as days since epoch. |
| `erasure_reason` | `string` | Stable machine code for why erasure happened (e.g. GDPR_ARTICLE_17) — never PII. |

## Governing ADRs

[ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md), [ADR-IC-016](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-016-service-identity-and-mtls.md), [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md)
